how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stonetalon-mountains-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6381:obj:0: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining ⟦E1⟧ to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6381:details:0: As you have seen, ⟦1⟧, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.
rows.quest:6381:details:1: B⟦2⟧, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
rows.quest:6381:progress:0: These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.⟦3⟧⟦4⟧Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
rows.quest:6381:completion:0: This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.
rows.quest:6381:completion:1: Only then ⟦5⟧, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.
rows.quest:6381:completion:2: You have done well ⟦6⟧; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
rows.quest:6393:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E3⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ at Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:6393:details:0: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.
rows.quest:6393:details:1: B⟦7⟧, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave ⟦E3⟧. Return these to me and be rewarded.
rows.quest:6393:progress:0: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the ⟦E3⟧ that I require?
rows.quest:6393:completion:0: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. ⟦8⟧, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
rows.quest:6393:completion:1: For your efforts, I reward you with a choice of my prized possessions.
rows.quest:1058:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of ⟦E6⟧, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1058:details:1: Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!
rows.quest:1058:details:2: I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.
rows.quest:1058:details:3: Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, ⟦9⟧, so I can brew some forest magic!
rows.quest:1058:progress:0: Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!⟦10⟧⟦11⟧Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?⟦12⟧⟦13⟧And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!
rows.quest:1058:completion:0: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!
rows.quest:1078:details:0: Travelers keep asking me about the ⟦E11⟧. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.
rows.quest:1078:details:1: Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.
rows.quest:1078:details:2: If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.
rows.quest:1078:details:3: Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
rows.quest:1078:progress:0: Hello again, ⟦14⟧.⟦15⟧⟦16⟧Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?
rows.quest:1078:completion:0: This is perfect, ⟦17⟧. Thank you greatly.
rows.quest:1078:completion:1: Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
rows.quest:1083:obj:0: Bring 8 ⟦E12⟧ from any of the fire elementals in the Charred Vale to ⟦E13⟧ in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1083:details:0: I'm unsure what the Venture Co. did to the Vale, but it's obvious they were overpowered by the creatures there.
rows.quest:1083:details:1: They set the forest aflame, and used their inventions of destruction to decimate as much of the Vale as possible.
rows.quest:1083:details:2: But in their ignorance they also released something else: burning spirits, elementals of flame, stone and rage.
rows.quest:1083:details:3: The land has no chance to see ⟦E15⟧'s smile while these creatures roam free.
rows.quest:1083:details:4: Bring me their smoldering embers to show you've reduced their numbers.
rows.quest:1083:progress:0: The first time I saw the Charred Vale I almost wept, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:1083:completion:0: The remains of our enemy... your strength serves us well, ⟦19⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:6282:obj:0: ⟦E17⟧ in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
rows.quest:6282:details:0: Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:6282:details:1: The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in ⟦E19⟧; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.
rows.quest:6282:details:2: I need you to cull the harpies, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:6282:progress:0: Do not be weary of Charred Vale; many evil creatures reside in those hills. Stay strong ⟦21⟧, and you shall prevail over this threat to our people. Go now and strike hard - our children shall never know of the evil of what was.
rows.quest:6282:completion:0: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
rows.quest:6283:obj:0: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay ⟦E23⟧ and bring her remains as proof of your deed.
rows.quest:6283:details:0: Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, ⟦E23⟧!
rows.quest:6283:details:1: She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.
rows.quest:6283:details:2: Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
rows.quest:6283:progress:0: ⟦E23⟧ is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.⟦22⟧⟦23⟧The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
rows.quest:6283:completion:0: Already I feel the anger leave me. What will I do with my time? Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. Perhaps this is a good thing... maybe now I can focus on the good, as all Tauren should.
rows.quest:6283:completion:1: Please accept this as a reward for your troubles.
rows.quest:86576:title: Bloodfury Trinkets
rows.quest:1057:obj:0: ⟦E26⟧ on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
rows.quest:1057:details:0: As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.
rows.quest:1057:details:1: You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.
rows.quest:1057:details:2: The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.
rows.quest:1057:progress:0: There is much work to be done before the Charred Vale can be restored to the lush forest it once was.⟦25⟧⟦26⟧Clear the area of those foul menaces, ⟦27⟧! Only then can we begin to reclaim what belongs to nature.
rows.quest:1057:completion:0: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
rows.quest:1059:obj:0: ⟦E27⟧ to ⟦E28⟧ on the border of ⟦E29⟧ and ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:1059:details:0: The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.
rows.quest:1059:details:1: Far south of the ⟦E31⟧ lies a land known as ⟦E29⟧. If you travel west in ⟦E29⟧ until you reach the lush forest's edge of ⟦E30⟧, you will find a druid named ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:1059:details:2: This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.
rows.quest:1059:details:3: Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!
rows.quest:1059:completion:0: ⟦E26⟧ was wise to send you with such urgency.
rows.quest:1059:completion:1: Let us see if we cannot call forth aid from the great forest to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
rows.quest:1095:obj:0: Bring the new orders to ⟦E32⟧ in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1095:details:0: The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.
rows.quest:1095:details:1: Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.
rows.quest:1095:details:2: Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
rows.quest:1095:completion:0: Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.
rows.quest:1095:completion:1: Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in ⟦E34⟧, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate ⟦E35⟧ well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
rows.quest:1096:obj:0: Bring ⟦E36⟧'s Mechanical Arm to ⟦E32⟧ in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1096:details:0: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.
rows.quest:1096:details:1: Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.
rows.quest:1096:details:2: If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
rows.quest:1096:progress:0: ⟦E37⟧ will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
rows.quest:1096:completion:0: Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!
rows.quest:1096:completion:2: At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and ⟦E37⟧ will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
rows.quest:1081:details:0: ⟦28⟧, I am sure ⟦E38⟧ herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.
rows.quest:1081:details:1: It may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1081:details:2: If you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E39⟧.
rows.quest:1081:completion:0: Hello, ⟦29⟧. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.
rows.quest:1081:completion:1: You would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.
rows.quest:1084:obj:0: Bring a piece of ⟦E40⟧ to ⟦E13⟧ in Stonetalon.
rows.quest:1084:details:0: It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale--the treants--had something to do with the Venture Co. being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.
rows.quest:1084:details:1: Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.
rows.quest:1084:details:2: I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded ⟦E41⟧ and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.
rows.quest:1084:details:3: Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...
rows.quest:1084:progress:0: I have a feeling Gaxim will find a use for the shrapnel regardless of how the Venture Co. has used it in the past.
rows.quest:1084:completion:1: This should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. I shall give this to him right away.
rows.quest:5881:obj:0: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to ⟦E42⟧ at the Great Lift in the ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:5881:details:0: The ⟦E43⟧ does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:5881:details:1: I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of ⟦E42⟧ protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
rows.quest:5881:completion:0: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!
rows.quest:1088:obj:0: Bring ⟦E44⟧' head to ⟦E45⟧ near Sun Rock Retreat.
rows.quest:1088:details:0: They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide ⟦E44⟧, but I will have his head!
rows.quest:1088:details:1: Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in ⟦E47⟧ Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.
rows.quest:1088:details:2: Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
rows.quest:1088:progress:0: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of ⟦E48⟧, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but ⟦E44⟧ had slipped my grasp.
rows.quest:1088:completion:0: I knew ⟦E44⟧ once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.
rows.quest:1088:completion:1: His head does not rise so high now, does it, ⟦31⟧?
rows.quest:1088:completion:2: I promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.
rows.quest:1089:obj:0: ⟦E27⟧ to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the ⟦E49⟧, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the ⟦E51⟧.
rows.quest:1089:details:0: The druids built the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, where they keep many powerful items.
rows.quest:1089:details:1: They devised a complex scheme to keep them from falling into the wrong hands.
rows.quest:1089:details:2: Luckily, I managed to... extract some details from one of them.
rows.quest:1089:details:3: Hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, you will find the ⟦E49⟧--with it you will be able to open caches around the Den. The items from these caches will allow you to open their hoard, located in one of the central areas.
rows.quest:1089:progress:0: Three keyholes are carved into the stone.
rows.quest:1089:completion:0: As the three keys are slid into their matching openings, in the middle of the glowing light a number of items appear.
